title: [BUG] TensorDictReplayBuffer's pin_memory=True does not work with custom transforms
author: kalyan0510

comments.author: vmoens
comments.body:
Good catch, we should move the decorator from `_sample` to `sample` here:
https://github.com/pytorch/rl/blob/e82a69f5af94cc936c4b872fd2ed499ed33b4f8e/torchrl/data/replay_buffers/replay_buffers.py#L655-L679
Note that this pin-memory implementation isn't very smart, see https://pytorch.org/tutorials/intermediate/pinmem_nonblock.html#:~:text=Importantly%2C%20pin_memory%20is%20blocking%20on,ones()%20and%20other%20constructors.
